units.source_text: 源氏内大臣一心要在朝廷重要节会仪式中增加一些新例，教后世之人传述，此乃冷泉帝时代所创始。

en.t: Genji, the Minister of the Interior, was determined to add certain new precedents to the important court festivals and ceremonies, so that people of later ages would tell of them; this practice began in the reign of Emperor Reizei.

units.source_text: 因此即使是赛画那种非正式的娱乐小事，也用心设计，务求美善。

en.t: Therefore, even for such an informal amusement as the picture contest, he planned everything with care and strove to make it beautiful and excellent.

units.source_text: 这真可说是全盛之世了！

en.t: It could truly be called an age of full splendor.

units.source_text: 然而源氏内大臣还是痛感人世之无常，闲时常常深思远虑：

en.t: Yet Genji, the Minister of the Interior, still felt keenly the impermanence of human life, and in quiet moments he often pondered deeply about the future.

units.source_text: 等到冷泉帝年事稍长之后，自己定当撒手遁入空门。

en.t: Once Emperor Reizei was a little older, he would surely let go of worldly affairs and enter the Buddhist path.
He thought, "Look at the examples of people in former times:

units.source_text: 凡年华鼎盛、官位尊荣、出人头地之人，大都不能长享富贵。

en.t: Those who were in the prime of life, honored with high rank, and raised above others generally could not enjoy wealth and nobility for long.

units.source_text: 我在当代，尊荣已属过分。

en.t: In this present age, the honor and glory I have received are already excessive.

units.source_text: 全靠中间惨遭灾祸，沦落多时，故得长生至今。

en.t: Only because I once suffered grievous misfortune and spent a long time in disgrace have I been able to live on until now.

units.source_text: 今后倘再留恋高位，难保寿命不永。

en.t: If from now on I remain attached to high office, I cannot be sure that my life will last long.

units.source_text: 倒不如入寺掩关，勤修佛法，既可为后世增福，又可使今生消灾延寿。”

en.t: It would be better to enter a temple, close the gate behind me, and diligently practice the Buddhist teachings; this would increase merit for the life to come and also remove calamities and lengthen this present life."

units.source_text: 便在郊外嵯峨山乡看定地区，建造佛堂。

en.t: He then selected a site in the mountain village of Saga outside the capital and built a Buddhist hall there.

units.source_text: 同时命人雕塑佛像，置备经卷。

en.t: At the same time, he ordered Buddhist images to be carved and scriptures to be prepared.

units.source_text: 但他一面又想按照己意抚育夕雾及明石姬所生女孩，看他们成长。

en.t: Yet at the same time he also wished to raise Yugiri and the daughter born to the Akashi lady according to his own intentions and watch them grow up.

units.source_text: 因此出家之事，一时难于实行。

en.t: For that reason, entering religious life was difficult for him to carry out for the time being.

units.source_text: 究竟作何打算，那就难以猜测预言了。

en.t: What he ultimately intended to do was hard to guess or foretell.
